hens_rule_text: Up to 6 hens allowed in a fenced rear yard on residential lots, with no permit required.
permit_notes: No bird-keeping permit is required; the zoning code simply designates where hens are a permitted use.
setback_notes: Coop must be at least 3 ft from any building on the owner's own property and 25 ft from any neighboring residence.
coop_rules: Hens must be kept in a fenced rear yard; general sanitation rules apply under the consolidated city-county animal code.
zoning_notes: Governed by the Indianapolis-Marion County consolidated code, Chapter 531 (Animals), together with the unified zoning code, which permits backyard hens in single-family residential (RS) and urban development zoning districts.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.

sources.name: BackYard Chickens forum, Indianapolis Indiana Chicken Ordinance
CityRuleLookup, Indianapolis IN Ordinances & Municipal Code

research_notes: The consolidated code (Municode-hosted) was not opened directly due to the region block and no Wayback copy was found; the 6-hen cap, no-permit status and 3 ft/25 ft setbacks come from secondary summaries only.
